name: Rusty Sword
description: A weathered blade with a 90-degree swing arc. Moderate reach and speed — a reliable all-rounder.

name: Bone Dagger
description: A quick, close-range shiv with a narrow 60-degree arc. Fastest swing speed, but shortest reach and lowest damage.

name: Broad Axe
description: A heavy cleaver with a wide 120-degree arc and long reach. Hits hard, but slow to swing.

name: Flame Blade
description: Searing steel that leaves pools of lava on every swing. Good reach and solid damage, with a built-in Lava Emitter.

name: Throwing Knife
description: A single fast-moving projectile that flies straight. Quick cooldown and longest projectile lifetime in its class.

name: Fire Orb
description: A slow-moving orb that hits hard up close. Short-lived but packs the heaviest single-shot ranged punch.

name: Spread Shot
description: Fires 3 projectiles in a 30-degree fan. Each bolt is weak, but landing all three deals heavy total damage.

name: Boss Staff
description: A rare arcane staff that fires a single bolt with a subtle spread. Longest projectile lifetime of any ranged weapon.

name: Willowblade
description: A living blade grown from heartwood. Tapping delivers quick swings and a charged thrust lands a guaranteed critical.

name: Flame Sword
description: A blade wreathed in fire. Critical strikes set foes ablaze to burn over time. Leaves a trail of molten lava in the wielder's wake.

name: Frost Sword
description: An ice-forged edge that swings in a wide arc. Critical hits freeze enemies solid, leaving them helpless for a moment.

name: Qinggang Light Sword
description: A legendary jade sword of the Three Kingdoms with alternating up-and-down swings.

name: Blood Blade
description: An assassin's blade that thirsts for blood; its edge glows crimson when charged. A full charge unleashes a rapid burst of lunging swings that carry the wielder forward into the fray.

name: Tao Sword
description: A heavy peachwood greatsword carved with Taoist talismans.

name: Dragon Fang
description: A spear-bladed greatsword shaped like a dragon's tooth. Each use delivers three lightning-fast thrusts in quick succession, skewering anything directly ahead without breaking the wielder's stride.

name: Heavenly Sword
description: A celestial blade pulled from still waters. Its wide, frost-touched swings freeze enemies on a critical hit, making it as much a tool of control as of slaughter.

name: Grand Knight's Sword
description: The motif weapon of the Grand Knight. A three-hit combo of two arcing slashes followed by a thrust. Devastating point-blank.

name: Deep Dark Blade
description: A cursed greatsword of the Dark Grand Knight. A forward spin followed by a grounded thrust.

name: Broadsword
description: A broad, heavy blade that carves a wide swing through everything in front of it. Holding the attack slows the wielder, but few common foes survive its sweep.

name: Executioner
description: A brutal headsman's blade. A tap chops once, but charging unleashes up to two spinning slashes of heavy damage. Short reach, yet quick to wind up and merciless.

name: Void Sword
description: A blade humming with a dark-azure singularity. Beginning a charge drags nearby enemies inward from every direction; release the full charge to cut down the helpless cluster in a single brutal arc.

name: Caliburn
description: The legendary sword drawn from stone. Its long reach and high critical chance shred crowds.

name: Phantom Blade
description: A spectral blade that strikes from beyond. A swift upward slash flows into a forward thrust, the ghostly edge passing through an enemy's guard as though it were not there.

name: Iron Mace
description: A blunt iron head that crushes armor and stuns on impact. Slow, but every hit rattles bone.

name: Rapier
description: A slender thrusting blade — lightning-fast, narrow reach, and a high crit chance that rewards precise jabs.

name: Bone Cleaver
description: A wide butcher's blade that opens deep, bleeding wounds with every chop.

name: War Scythe
description: A sweeping reaper's blade with a broad arc that catches foes to the flanks and behind.

name: Twin Daggers
description: Paired blades that strike twice per swing — low damage each, brutal in sum.

name: Obsidian Greatsword
description: A massive volcanic blade that cleaves through stone as easily as flesh.

name: Venom Fang Blade
description: A serpentine edge that injects venom on contact, poisoning foes that survive the cut.

name: Tide Caller
description: A coral blade that weeps seawater, soaking foes and the ground for freeze combos.

name: Cinder Brand
description: A smoldering sword that sets struck foes ablaze.

name: Glacier Edge
description: A blade of eternal ice that chills foes toward a killing freeze.

name: Thunder Katana
description: A storm-forged katana whose critical cuts arc lightning between foes.

name: Gravedigger's Spade
description: A heavy spade that doubles as a tunneling tool, blasting through soft earth.

name: Reaper's Glaive
description: A soul-drinking glaive that mends its wielder with each life it reaps.

name: Berserker's Axe
description: The closer to death you swing, the harder it bites.

name: Mirror Blade
description: A polished blade whose swing deflects incoming projectiles.

name: Whirlwind Blade
description: A charged spin sweeps a full circle, striking every foe around the wielder.

name: Quake Hammer
description: A colossal maul whose charged slam sends a knockback shockwave through the ground.

name: Soul Reaver
description: A cursed blade that grows stronger with every soul it claims this fight.

name: Heavy Crossbow
description: Fires a single heavy bolt that punches through the first foe it meets.

name: Scatter Blunderbuss
description: Belches a wide cone of pellets — devastating point-blank, near useless at range.

name: Arc Railgun
description: A charged rail-shot that pierces everything in a line.

name: Flame Lobber
description: Lobs clay pots that shatter into pools of lava on impact.

name: Frost Repeater
description: A rapid bow that peppers foes with chilling icicles.

name: Venom Spitter
description: Spits globs that burst into clouds of poison gas.

name: Tesla Gun
description: Fires forking bolts of lightning that leap between foes.

name: Chakram Launcher
description: Hurls a returning chakram that slices foes coming and going.

name: Seeker Launcher
description: Looses homing missiles that chase down fleeing foes.

name: Hailstorm Bow
description: Rains a volley of icicles across a wide area.
